The '''Attack on Centa Sonhan's sail barge''' was a battle that occurred on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
After discovering the existence of his [[Bafforr tree]] grove, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer, [[Ingah Muloha]] decided to capture [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]] because of this subversive behavior. She contacted an Imperial sympathizer, the crime lord [[Centa Sonhan]] and he captured Nadon and held him aboard [[Centa Sonhan's sail barge|his sail barge]].

A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] team set out to free Nadon and they learned the location of the sail barge from the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Information broker/Legends|Information broker]], [[Ladira]].

==The battle==
The Alliance attacked the barge, killing some of the Imperials and Centa Sohan. They were then able to free Nadon. However, the sail barge drifted into the path of a gravel storm and a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]]. The Alliance team were able to escape with Nadon in their speeder and left the sail barge to be destroyed by the storm and the dragon.

==Aftermath==
The local Imperial commander, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Harburik]] assumed that his men and the sail barge had been lost in the gravel storm, so was none the wiser to what had really occurred.
